_provenance: Contribution/expenditure searches with 'Export Results to CSV Only', window 4/1/2026-6/30/2026, run live 2026-08-26. Sums grouped by exact Recipient/Payer; [LDF] = rows whose Report contains 'Legal Defense Fund'.
rule: itemized CSV sum: lines(1+5) <= sum <= lines(1+5+7) for contributions; lines(9+10) <= sum <= lines(9+10+11) for expenditures. Filers MAY itemize <=$100 transactions (Krasner did; the others did not). Headline totals must come from summary lines 8/12, never from CSV sums.

exp.verdict: exact at 9+10; LDF rows separately equal LDF report line 9

annual_semantics: On Annual CE Filings (period = full prior calendar year), the This-Period and Cumulative columns are identical: the filing is self-contained and NOT part of the CE#1-#4 cumulative chain (CE#1 cumulative == CE#1 period, i.e. the chain restarts each election year).
amended_semantics: hansen CE4-2024 amended differs from original (line1 35000 vs 33500; line11 0 vs 423.47); cannizzaro annual-2026 amended kept identical totals (itemization-only amendment). Transaction search returns ONLY the amended report's rows.
